title: My Soulmate Is In The Mall
content: Okay, so I wish I could record a voice note, so tou could hear how serious my voice is. I type in a giddy way, because A) I'm bi and B) I don't like typing because it has no way of encoding tone except through Pop Culture references which have a kind of "voice". So, if this reads unusual, it's because this is an unusual thing. So up until about 2 minutes ago, I didn't know that anybody else knew about The Mall. I honestly feel like I'm just saying stuff now and 2 seconds later it's manifesting. I can't believe there's a whole group on The Mall. I didn't want to read any posts so I'm gonna describe my best trip to The Mall and the closest thing I saw that resembles it kinda. So I came down this mountain, running down the mountain while these old folks were going up the mountain. These people were chasing me, trying to get me back to their dimension. Suddenly I'm running towards The Mall, and it was kind of like The Mall is a safezone. I just knew that I had to get through those sliding doors. So I'm running and they're gaining (we were dressed like that TV show Shadowhunters)...and I make it into The Mall and the other guys just stop and giving and take a breath. Then I look up at the giant silver escalator and my soulmate was standing right there. I just knew. Sometimes I go out of The Mall and I'm in this town that looks like Venice. Sometimes I'm with this group of people and we're wearing kinda like "spacesuits" but we're not in space. We're inside the earth but it has its own sky. Sometimes there's mermaids and merman and ships and seraphim etc. But the one thing I love about it is how technologically advanced it is. And EVERYBODY is so so so genuine and nice (the people in the "space suits"). But inside The Mall there's all sorts of different people. You can sense who is from earth and who is from the inside. I sense all of this knowledge in the dream. I just know it. I've designed my art around this thing amdnI can't believe other people know this...so that means Carl Jung was right after all. I meant why aren't we being studied? This is a doozie. I guess people think we're Larping. But who wants to be taken as crazy by everyone? It would be easier to go to bed like everyone else, but I think this is fascinating. Possibly Important Facts: I'm Zulu and I have been exposed to a lot of deep psychological experiences through my research assignments. And somehow they all seem to keep coming true in my face.
